mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5%, indicating a tight labor market, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, due to increased consumer spending and business investment.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month, signaling strong supply chain activity, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers and suppliers benefit.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO growth > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annualized growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 6-month moving average predicts the direction of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with higher rates relative to the average indicating positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or the strategy's Sharpe ratio is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) has been growing for at least 3 consecutive months, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, due to increased consumer confidence and spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth for 3+ months
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market and consumer spending correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in a month, indicating strong consumer demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as retailers and consumer discretionary sectors benefit.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
